title: AI labs are buying data from dead startups to train their models
hook_text: Failed startups are now cashing out
script:
Keelan Miskell shut down his crypto startup this year.
He sold his code base for twenty-five thousand dollars.
Miskell expects even more from a separate pending data deal.
AI labs are actively buying these digital archives to train models.
Startups previously considered their user data worthless after shutting down.
Buyers prioritize unique code and historical interactions to improve performance.
This trend gives founders a way to recoup initial losses.
Would you sell your failed company's data for cash?

editor.one_line: Visually repetitive and lacks a compelling hook; needs more dynamic, varied imagery.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Start with the dollar amount to hook the viewer: 'Failed startups are selling their data for thousands of dollars.'
LINE 4: Name specific AI labs if possible, or replace 'AI labs' with 'Companies like OpenAI or Anthropic' if supported by the source.
LINE 8: Make the question more provocative: 'Would you sell your users' data to save your failing business?'
